title: Korean idiom quiz 🌬️⭐☀️ "hit by the wind" = you got STOOD UP?! Can you guess all 3? #learnkorean
caption:
Can you guess these 3 Korean sky & weather idioms in 3 seconds? 🌬️⭐☀️

바람맞다 — not “hit by the wind”: the person you were meeting never showed up (you got stood up)
하늘의 별 따기 — not just “picking a star from the sky”: something super hard to get
해가 서쪽에서 뜨다 — not “the sun rises in the west”: something that never happens… just happened

Say it: 바람맞았어요 · 하늘의 별 따기예요 · 해가 서쪽에서 뜨겠어요

How many did you get? Comment your score 0/3 – 3/3 👇

alt: Felt mascot Mongle hosts a Korean idiom quiz. A felt teddy bear blown back by blue wind swirls, the bear on a ladder grabbing a smiling star, and a grinning sun rising over green hills next to a confused rooster show the literal readings of 바람맞다, 하늘의 별 따기 and 해가 서쪽에서 뜨다; the bear sitting alone on a park bench with flowers, the bear at the very back of a long ticket line, and the bear shocked to see his little brother washing the dishes show the real meanings.
